versions.content: For Offset Time Bases the Main Time Tuple shall be updated according to [SWS_StbM_00441] , [SWS_StbM_00190] and [SWS_StbM_00304] . Specification of Synchronized Time - Base Manager AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 64 of 186 Document ID 421 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SynchronizedTimeBaseManager - AUTOSAR confidential - In case of StbM_SetRateCorrection() the StbM shall calculate a temporary Time Tuple according to [SWS_StbM_00424] and replace the Main Time Tuple by this temporary Time Tuple.

For Offset Time Bases the Main Time Tuple shall be updated according to [SWS_StbM_00441] , [SWS_StbM_00190] and [SWS_StbM_00304] . Specification of Synchronized Time - Base Manager AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 58 of 189 Document ID 421 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SynchronizedTimeBaseManager Upon invocation of StbM_SetRateCorrection() the StbM shall calculate a temporary Time Tuple according to [SWS_StbM_00424] and replace the Main Time Tuple by this temporary Time Tuple. For calculation of the temporary Time Tuple StbM shall use the r value, which is valid before it is updated by current call of StbM_SetRateCorrection() .

For Offset Time Bases the Main Time Tuple shall be updated according to [SWS_StbM_00441] , [SWS_StbM_00190] and [SWS_StbM_00304] . Upon invocation of StbM_SetRateCorrection() the StbM shall calculate a temporary Time Tuple according to [SWS_StbM_00424] and replace the Main Time Tuple by this temporary Time Tuple. For calculation of the temporary Time Tuple StbM shall use the r value, which is valid before it is updated by current call of StbM_SetRateCorrection() .
